reasoning: The baseline Random Forest achieved 94.71% CV accuracy with no regularization, showing a small train/CV gap (0.0529). The Logistic Regression candidate (iter01_c1) improved to 96.79% by adding standard scaling and balanced class weights, indicating that linear separation is highly effective here. The Stacking ensemble (iter01_c3) reached the highest score (97.17%) by combining Extra Trees and Logistic Regression via soft voting. To refine this strong baseline, we will create a new stacking configuration that diversifies the base learners: replacing the Random Forest in the previous stack with a Gradient Boosting model to test if boosting's gradient-based optimization complements the tree-based ensemble better than the random forest. We also adjust the LR C parameter slightly to 0.8 to test sensitivity within the effective range.

Test the hypothesis that a simpler pipeline with fewer estimators and deeper trees might generalize better than the complex stacking setup, potentially reducing variance while maintaining performance.
